agent_prompt_mixed_group: KuBhuku lami "{book}", Iqembu {group} lihlanganisa amabhalansi (Impahla, Isikweletu) nomsebenzi (Okungenayo, Okuphumayo). Ngisize ngiwahlukanise abe ngamaqembu awo. Shintsha amaqembu kuphela, hhayi Ukuthengiselana.
agent_prompt_no_net_result: Ibhuku lami "{book}" alinawo umphumela ohlanzekile: alikho Iqembu elihlanganisa {incoming} no-{outgoing}. Ngisize ngihlele amaqembu alo ukuze imali engenayo nezindleko zihlangane eQenjini elilodwa. Shintsha amaqembu kuphela, hhayi Ukuthengiselana.
agent_prompt_no_net_result_general: Ibhuku lami "{book}" alinawo umphumela ohlanzekile: alikho Iqembu elihlanganisa imali yalo engenayo nezindleko. Ngisize ngihlele amaqembu alo ukuze imali engenayo nezindleko zihlangane eQenjini elilodwa. Shintsha amaqembu kuphela, hhayi Ukuthengiselana.
agent_prompt_no_net_result_shared: Ibhuku lami "{book}" alinawo umphumela ohlanzekile: amaqembu alo {shared} abelana ngama-akhawunti. Ngisize ngihlele amaqembu alo ukuze imali engenayo nezindleko zihlangane eQenjini elilodwa. Shintsha amaqembu kuphela, hhayi Ukuthengiselana.
agent_prompt_nothing_to_report: Ibhuku lami "{book}" alinakho okungabikwa: {count} kuma-akhawunti alo angu-{total} anokuthengiselana awekho kunoma yiliphi iqembu. Ngisize ngiwahlele ngamaqembu emibiko, njenge-balance sheet ne-income statement. Shintsha amaqembu kuphela, hhayi Ukuthengiselana.
